notes.title: Valkyria Chronicles 4 Complete Edition Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967905/2165052983ea7aaad80a4a4489b6450a134f366b.png

Valkyria Chronicles 4 has been updated to the Complete Edition which now includes all bonus DLC!

Previous owners of Valkyria Chronicles 4 will automatically receive the Complete Edition content. 

Squad E, move out!

notes.title: VC4 Patch 3 deployed! - 15 October 2018
notes.content:
Hi Valkyria fans,

Patch 3 has rolled out with some small improvements:

•	Option to set cutscenes to letter boxed for players using ultra wide resolutions
•	Fix for hard lock seen in later chapters
•	Tweaks for fixes to the controller drift issues
•	UI and localisation tidy up

That's it for today, Squad E.
-SEGA Dev

notes.title: VC4 Patch 2 rolls out! - 01 October 2018
notes.content:
Hi Valkyria fans,

Patch 2 is now live on the main default branch. Thanks to everyone who provided feedback on our beta version.

The patch fixes the following:

•       Fix for dialogue freezing for some users in some scenes 
•	Localisation fixes
•	Added a Toggle Walk option for keyboard input (please check the key rebinding screen for more info)
•	A  fix for a camera drift/scrolling menus issue (please note some users are still experiencing this issue after the beta patch; we're continuing to investigate)
•	A fix for an error on shutdown when running in widescreen 

Cheers,
-SEGA Dev

notes.title: VC4 Patch 1 is live - 27 September 2018
notes.content:
Hi soldiers,

Patch 1 is out for some quick fixes. There will be more to follow, so stay tuned.

VC4 v1.01 patch notes:

•	Walk has been added to the d-pad 
•	Various localisation bug fixes
•	Fix for a black screen fade in later chapters
•	Tweaks to tank controls

Thanks, 
SEGA Dev
